'''Sooloot''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a [[Lore Keeper|scholar]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who most notably remarked on the origins of the [[Chosen One/Legends|Prophecy of the Chosen One]].

==Biography==
A [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Sooloot studied the [[Chosen One/Legends|Prophecy of the Chosen One]] before concluding that it was written down sometime around the [[First Great Schism]]. As to the mention of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Sooloot believed that the mention of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the prophecy was added at a later date for clarification of the intended meaning. Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Fae Coven]] remarked on Sooloot's beliefs in the chapter entitled, ''The Prophecy of the Chosen One'' within her [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] guidebook, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. However, the text about the Chosen One was later removed by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]].<ref name="TJP" />
